name: cenno-public
description: Creative direction for stands, indoor and outdoor events and Christmas, plus rendering and animation planning.

interface.longDescription: Cenno helps event professionals and students develop creative pre-designs for exhibition stands, indoor corporate events, outdoor events and seasonal Christmas installations, plus photo opportunities, event renders and animation planning. Eleven focused skills include a neutral workflow selector and ten specialties. Stand, indoor and Christmas design provide text-based concepts, spatial planning, English prompts, a modeling handoff guide and descriptive inventories; they do not create 3D models or generate media. Christmas design considers theme, tree, activities and existing inventory supplied through photos and dimensions, including seasonal decoration for malls, outdoor spaces, homes and offices. Other skills cover drone shots, virtual tours, construction timelapses and plenary-to-dinner transformations. Starts immediately without a conversational password or language-selection step. Conversation automatically follows the user's language; visual prompts remain in English. Media generation depends on tools and limits in each user account. The remote MCP calculator estimates photo opportunity composition for 1 to 12 people; it does not generate media, persist briefings, call an AI API, purchase services or perform structural calculations. Outputs are creative pre-designs, not construction documents or safety certifications. Dedicated light-show animation is not included.

prompts: Olá! O que posso criar com o Cenno?
I want creative direction for a 6 by 4 metre corner exhibition stand for a coffee brand. I already have the brandbook and floor plan. Start with the missing briefing information.
Tenho um congresso interno com plenária e foyer. Já enviei público, agenda e planta. Quero traduzir o KV aprovado para essas duas áreas sem repetir o briefing.
Quero Natal em uma praça de shopping. Tenho árvore, guirlandas e brinquedos no acervo. Como começamos a aproveitar as peças?
Quero só um photo opportunity natalino para o escritório, sem árvore nem atividades. Tenho uma foto do acervo, mas ainda não tenho as medidas.
O conceito, implantação e peças do estande já estão aprovados. Prepare as instruções textuais de modelagem 3D e o memorial; marque dados ausentes como pendentes.
Quero renderizar um print de um estande já concebido, sem refazer sua direção criativa.
Quero planejar a virada de uma plenária em jantar, preservando a sala.

publication.release_notes: Removes the conversational password and mandatory language-selection step across all eleven skills and their supporting references. Starts directly from the user request or the neutral workflow menu and automatically follows the user language, with explicit language changes respected. Visual prompts remain in English. Preserves the existing workflows, assets, approved MCP endpoint, tools, hosting, privacy, commerce and country targeting. No new authentication or data collection.
